note: PEANUT WARNING: the pack prints, verbatim, 'CONTAINS WHEAT (GLUTEN), MILK AND SOYBEAN PRODUCTS. MAY CONTAIN OTHER CEREALS CONTAINING GLUTEN, SESAME SEEDS, EGGS AND SULPHITES. MADE IN A BAKERY HANDLING PEANUTS AND TREE NUTS.' Peanuts and tree nuts come from that bakery sentence, not from a may-contain list, but they are listed under mayContain here so a filter cannot miss them. 'ingredients' is in needs because glare obscures two fragments in the first line (the fat and the antioxidant name); '(307b:Soy)', 'Coconut', and 'Contains 11% Coconut' are clearly legible. Front of pack reads 'Deliciously Coconutty Crunch', 250g NET.
